question: Does declaring tracked immutable encoded heaps instead of individual record resources reduce idle driver gaps without changing computation?

parameters.one_factor: On the same retained tracked placement heaps, A1/A2 declare individual source resources; B declares their unique source heaps read-only. All output/index hazard tracking, exact kernels,64record submission,mixed-tail settings unchanged.
parameters.planned_matrix: Full66 frozen Linux products and nine recorded native masks. Warm135 and4s idle54 complete queries, A/B/A; prior output hashes and release; no app adoption without load nonregression.
parameters.safety: No aliasing, raw4Dresident, source/index growth, changed hashing, source reads or hidden reduced outputs. useHeaps only for immutable tracked encoded backing per Apple Metal API; absent heap fails closed.
parameters.basis: Prior heap-only experiment exact189 but warm neutral, idle mixed and0.2-0.3s loading regression, so not adopted. This isolates argument-resource declaration, not allocation policy.
parameters.timing: Prepared entropy/source pages unspecified; package query wall primary, not native FPS. Driver metric is last command only; sum GPU command intervals is not shader-active time.
parameters.preflight: 8/8 tests pass, no compiler warnings: heap exact readback/failure/retry and fulluint16/escape/zero/mixed/signed decoder fixtures. The full66 runtime-declaration arm is the scientific API test of useHeaps.
parameters.result: REFUTED: 135 warm and 54 four-second-idle full66 comparisons exact. Warm timing neutral: case7 p50 A/B/A 263.830/263.358/263.771ms. Idle remains variable: case7 418.733/410.131/455.247ms; case1 410.882/408.339/392.014ms. No consistent gain versus both controls and last-command driver intervals remain about10ms. Raw analysis is authoritative.
parameters.decision: No app adoption; defaultoff. Same source/index/heaps and no extra scientific resident. Results do not qualify 10/20/120FPS or loading nonregression.
